name: @data-cleaning/adapter-openrefine
description: OpenRefine headless 引擎 adapter：HTTP 客户端 + 生命周期托管 + 契约测试（M0 PoC 用例集演化）

scripts.test: vitest run; s=$?; pkill -15 -f "data-cleaning/workspace/engine-data.*com.google.refine.Refine" >/dev/null 2>&1; sleep 2; pkill -9 -f "data-cleaning/workspace/engine-data.*com.google.refine.Refine" >/dev/null 2>&1; exit $s
